lens: SwiftUI state correctness, gesture ownership, deletion recoverability, scoped Ask authorization, and test integrity
strengths: The multi-context People Ask bypass is fail-closed in policy, filtered scope selection, Send state, send handling, and zero-request E2E coverage.
Per-destination visible anchors close the whole-page remount continuity risk for the tested paths; 50-row E2Es verify same-tab reset, cross-tab return, detail return, and background recovery.
Single-session deletion has a transactional rollback path, retained drafts, explicit failure handling, exact confirmation, unit coverage, and UI coverage.
Destination selection is isolated to top controls, row gestures remain native List gestures, long press mirrors governed actions, and the latency artifact records warmed methodology and the App hash.
The final frozen evidence reports 13 of 13 core tests and 2 of 2 visual tests passing and binds the App, UI-test binary, xctestrun, source-at-build, and result bundles.
